sentences.en: Are your opinions representative of those of the other students?
sentences.zh: 你的意见能代表其他同学的观点吗？

sentences.en: The Representative said he will put a brake on spending.
sentences.zh: 这位代表说他会控制开支。

sentences.en: Whoever the representative is from their division, treat him well.
sentences.zh: 无论他们部门派来的是哪位代表，都要好好招待他。

senses.zh: 典型的，有代表性的；代议制的；表现的，体现的；与表象有关的
代表；典型；众议员；销售代表
